description: This Java class handles the command for settling cash from a cashier within the organizational teller module of the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface and delegates the action to the teller write platform service.

classes.name: SettleCashFromCashierCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class that processes the 'SETTLECASHFROMCASHIER' command by invoking the suitable service method.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to settle cash from a cashier by delegating to the teller write platform service.
